findings.text: Acceptance 1 fails in a direct-handler test: IDs 100..149, 1,000-char bodies except ID 149 (60,000). read_conversation({conversation_id:3,limit:50}) returns 140..149 and before=140; following with {conversation_id:3,before:140} returns 120..139 without a cursor, leaving 20 requested messages unseen. The default limit hides remaining rows. Preserve pagination state or emit a cursor for full API pages; add mixed-size tests that follow the printed cursor.

Acceptance 1: with one 60,000-char message ending END-MARKER, direct calls to read_conversation({conversation_id:3,around:100,limit:1}) and read_thread({message_id:100}) produced tailPresent=false,cursor=false (base: tailPresent=true). Reusing frameItem/budgeted discards the body after roughly 40,000 chars; the REST fallback is unavailable to wake runs. Add a supported continuation for the omitted body within the existing tool set and total budget.
